parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of a wall switch, made of ABS plastic. It is the movable component that toggles between on and off positions.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for controlling the electrical circuit, allowing current to flow or stop when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or depresses slightly when toggled, returning to its stable position after actuation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism securely and attaches to the wall or electrical box, ensuring safety and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
